geometry_analysis.width_description: Uniform width, but surface continuity is destroyed.
geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Convex reinforcement, heavily disrupted by voids.

visual_anomalies.visual_description: A dense cluster of deep, black, circular holes immediately at the Start (Left). It resembles a sponge or honeycomb structure.
Large, elongated, and round deep voids scattered along the entire body of the weld, penetrating deep into the bead.
Numerous irregular patches of rust-brown glassy material adhered to the surface between the pores.

surface_state.discoloration: Mix of metallic grey, deep black voids, and brown slag patches
